The '''Special Forces black ops program''' was a division of the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] that performed covert military operations during the [[Great Galactic War]] and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Overseen by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]], the head of the [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]] Division, black ops carried out missions that were deemed illegal or unsuitable for standard Special Forces units. One black ops unit, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] named the [[Surgeons]], was charged with [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] enemy leaders, though its members were arrested and convicted of war crimes when they began pursuing the families of their assigned targets.

==History==
{{Quote|They renamed my old squad 'the Surgeons.' Tasked them with destabilizing the Empire's command structure by removing its best leaders.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
Founded sometime after the official establishment of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] in [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the Special Forces black ops program was overseen by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]],<ref name="The Surgeons" /> who also led the overall [[Special forces/Legends|Special Forces]] Division.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Sometime after [[3665 BBY]], Garza personally recruited into black ops the members of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] that had previously been under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. The members of the squad, among them the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Karsim]], [[Naja]], and [[Eckerd]], underwent black ops training, and the newly-named [[Surgeons]] were then assigned the mission of destabilizing the command structure of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]&mdash;with which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was currently fighting the [[Great Galactic War]]&mdash;by taking out the Empire's military leaders.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

However, the Surgeons began to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the families of their targets, believing that their actions would demoralize the Empire and help the Republic. The Surgeons were soon arrested and tried for war crimes, and the members of the squad were all given life sentences when they openly confessed their actions. [[Republic officer/Legends|Officers]] of the [[Republic Army]] were aware of the existence of the black ops program by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]], when Rusk inquired into the fate of his former squad and discovered that its members had been [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Berrun detention center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berrun]].<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Equipment and training==
{{Quote|Black ops doesn't make heroes. It trains killers. If the right targets die, no one complains.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="The Surgeons" />}}
Members of the black ops program underwent training in assassination and covert operations, and the program instilled a mentality in which the ends justified the means when it came to striking blows against the enemy. Sergeant Fideltin Rusk considered the members of his first squad to be some of the finest soldiers with which he had ever served, and he was dismayed to learn that their [[Time/Legends|time]] in black ops had turned them into killers.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Fideltin Rusk first mentioned the Special Forces black ops program in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]], during the conversation "The Surgeons."<ref name="The Surgeons" />
